notes.title: Update#9 - More newbie friendly features.
notes.content:
Today we bring you a new update! And we will keep updating the game to give you the best possible gameplay experience.

:fvwatch: Most players gather together and play in 8 ~ 12 oclock in the night (UTC+8 time), join us and battle together!

# Rank now shows to everyone in the room and battlefield.
# Players ranked as Hastati gets an extra +500 HP , Miles gets an extra +100 HP.
# Character now has no level limitations to lower the difficulty for new players to join the game.
# Equipment and Item now has rank limitation when you buy it.
# Bug fix: Toughness didn't work for EN or MP reduction.
# Add game guide for newbie players: Game rules.
# You are now able to preview the character detail before buying it.
# When playing 1v2, 2v3 and 3v4 game. The team with lesser players will trigger last-stand-buff once it has lesser Team Score to the opponents.

If you have any suggestions and ideas regarding for balancing the game then leave us a message in our discussion thread. https://steamcommunity.com/app/787400/discussions/0/1696048245846964365 

We will read every single comment and make sure to consider them for future updates.

Should you not be able to see any other online players in the game make sure that you have updated the game. Should it not update use the "verify files" in the property settings of the game in the steam library.

notes.title: Update#8 - Show your Rank!
notes.content:
Today we bring you a new update! And we will keep updating the game to give you the best possible gameplay experience.

:fvwatch: Most players gather together and play in 8 ~ 12 oclock in the night (UTC+8 time), join us and battle together!

So here is what is new:

# Ranks: Collect honor points in the battle and level up your rank!
# When your rank reaches the level "Decurion", you will not be able to collect any additional honor points in singleplayer. To level up further you need to play multiplayer.
# To keep leveling up with the rank "Decurion" and higher you need to collect a certain amount of honor per battle. In the case that you do not meet the target you will lose honor points instead.
# Leftover Gold from previous game sessions will be converted 1:1 to honor points.
# Default Quick messages changed to: Defend the Tower, Attack, Focus on Defense

Balance Changes:
# Farmer Defense 18 > 22
# Tamer's Talent: Activates at less than 35% HP > Activates when SP is higher than 35%; Skill 2 requires MP 26>20
# Elven Warrior Skill 3 speed down 13%
# Sun Priest Talent Toughness 50% > 0% ( no more Toughness )
# Item Cheese COST 100>200, recover MP 8 > 12, Carries 2 > 3 
# Item Water COST 200>300, recover MP 12 > 16
# Item Wine COST 300>400
# Item Bread COST 300 > 250
# Item Pork COST 700 > 750

If you have any suggestions and ideas regarding for balancing the game then leave us a message in our discussion thread. https://steamcommunity.com/app/787400/discussions/0/1696048245846964365 

We will read every single comment and make sure to consider them for future updates.

Should you not be able to see any other online players in the game make sure that you have updated the game. Should it not update use the "verify files" in the property settings of the game in the steam library.
